description: Obfuscated WebAssembly (Wasm) cryptographic key verification module -- a insane-tier reverse engineering challenge. Review the bundled artifacts, locate the encoded clue, decode it, and recover the flag. Flag format: pwn{...}
objectives: Inspect the challenge bundle for "Obfuscated WebAssembly (Wasm) cryptographic key verification module"
